name: Aketashi Yui
source: Hiroshi's younger childhood friend from Gokurakuin orphanage. She becomes a first year in the same high school school as Hiroshi and Ai when they move onto their third year. Yui has a very strong sense of justice and immediately after enrolling, becomes a public morals commitee member. She's been in love with Hiroshi for nearly ten years already.
